official_sources: Heat Networks Delivery Unit and zoning pipeline

official_measurement_examples.name: Regulatory commencement
official_measurement_examples.fact: Ofgem's heat-network authorisation conditions came into effect on 27 January 2026.

official_measurement_examples.name: Deemed authorisation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Ofgem states operating heat networks were automatically authorised to continue regulated heat-network activities under the new regime.

official_measurement_examples.name: Registration deadline
official_measurement_examples.fact: Ofgem's central heat-networks guidance currently states relevant operators and suppliers must provide registration details by 26 January 2027.

official_measurement_examples.name: Registration service timing
official_measurement_examples.fact: Ofgem guidance says registration information can be submitted through its digital service from April 2026.

official_measurement_examples.name: Zoning implementation status
official_measurement_examples.fact: DESNZ states the zoning implementation statutory instrument is being drafted and a future five-year pipeline is being developed.

official_measurement_examples.name: Zoning consultation response
official_measurement_examples.fact: Government published its response to the detailed 2023 heat-network-zoning consultation on 21 January 2026.

official_measurement_examples.name: Technical standards status
official_measurement_examples.fact: The January 2026 HNTAS technical-standards publication is a consultation on proposed regulatory technical standards.

official_measurement_examples.name: Consumer protection scope
official_measurement_examples.fact: Ofgem consumer-protection guidance covers conduct, service, billing, contracts, vulnerable consumers and security of supply.
